subject: Escrow & evidence handoff: reseller addendum protocol
messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@cloudstax.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cloudstax.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Reseller addendum — escrow trigger & evidence checklist

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the time earlier. As we move toward signing the reseller addendum for listing Redwood on CloudStax Marketplace, procurement needs explicit confirmation on two items so our legal/finance teams can clear the order form: 

1) Escrow trigger — CloudStax requires the ability to place escrow on marketplace funds if we detect fee pass-through discrepancies. We need Redwood's proposed escrow activation threshold and the responsible contact.
2) Evidence handoff — a checklist of documents (audit logs, invoice trails, orderform IDs) we can expect when CloudStax requests an audit. Attached is our standard evidence checklist for reference.

Can you confirm owners, timeline (we're targeting countersign in 5 business days), and an initial set of attachments you will provide?

Appreciate it — Anita
[Attachment: cloudstax_evidence_checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

From: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: Anita Singh <anita.singh@cloudstax.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — escrow trigger & evidence checklist

Hi Anita — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. Internal owners below and an initial timeline proposal: 

- Escrow trigger owner (operations/legal): Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com) — he'll propose threshold language and trigger events.
- Evidence handoff owner (finance/ops): Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) — he'll provide invoice traceability mapping and sample audit export.
- Sales sign-off / coordination: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)

What we can commit to immediately:
- A draft escrow clause and trigger thresholds by EOD tomorrow (Sep 30).
- A packaged evidence bundle (sample invoice trail, orderform IDs, audit log export format) within 2 business days.

I am attaching our standard escrow draft so legal can start redlining. If there are any non-standard fields CloudStax requires in the audit bundle, flag them now. We'll aim to have a DocuSign envelope ready after internal sign-off.

Olga
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redwood_escrow_agreement_draft.pdf]

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, Anita Singh <legal@cloudstax.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — escrow trigger & evidence checklist

On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Hi Anita — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. Internal owners below and an initial timeline proposal:

Team — first pass from legal attached (reseller_addendum_redline_v2). Key points: 

- Proposed escrow activation: material revenue reconciliation variance > 2% over a rolling 30-day window, or confirmed invoice duplication. Thresholds flexible if CloudStax provides historical variance data.
- Evidence scope: invoice CSV export (orderform_id, invoice_id, line_items, unit_price, reseller_fee), tokenized audit logs for API calls (timestamped, requester id), and a signed attestation from our finance lead.
- Retention and access: propose 90-day immediate retention for fast audits, with long-term archival accessible via secure SFTP for requests older than 90 days.

Anita/CloudStax legal — please confirm if the 2% variance and 90-day retention meet your procurement team's expectations, or send counter-thresholds.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: reseller_addendum_redline_v2.docx (Word)]

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, Anita Singh <procurement@cloudstax.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — escrow trigger & evidence checklist

Thanks — adding the finance perspective. A few operational notes: 

- Invoice mapping: we'll export a CSV that includes orderform_id, partner_id, reseller_fee_percent, gross_amount, net_pass_through_amount, invoice_date, and payment_reference. I've attached the proposed CSV header sample.
- Escrow mechanics: Redwood can accept a short-term hold (escrow) routed through our payment processor for up to 30 days pending reconciliation. For longer holds we will need explicit authorization and an SLA for dispute resolution.
- SLA ask: we can agree to a 10-business-day dispute resolution window for issues that meet the escrow trigger; if unresolved, funds move to escrow per the clause.

I'll add a sample export and would like CloudStax to confirm the file schema matches what your accounting system expects.

Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice_map.csv (CSV, header sample)]
